sources.title: Ofis Square contact page
sources.reviewNote: Support block labels +91 82879 91481 as “Sales”. The site-wide footer invites workspace requirements with “Call +91 95600 50321 for swift solutions”. Neither is labelled for events or for one branch. Unlabelled sales@/hello@ addresses on a different ofisspaces.com domain were not stored. The events page’s “Book An Event Space” block is a mailing-list sign-up, not a booking form.

sources.title: Ofis Square coworking space, Noida Sector 62
sources.reviewNote: Branch FAQ: “For booking assistance at our coworking space in Noida Sector 62, contact hello@ofissquare.com.” It does not mention event spaces.

sources.title: Contact SAIACS CEO Centre — room bookings and event enquiries
sources.reviewNote: “Call Our Team” lists +91 9606008031 and +91 9606008032 for the reservations and events team; “Email Us” gives ceoenquiry@saiacs-ceocenter.com for booking requests and event requirements. The separate footer address and WhatsApp number carry no events label and were not stored.

sources.title: Masters’ Union contact page
sources.reviewNote: “Contact Us: info@mastersunion.org” is the general address. Admissions, media and programme addresses on the same page are not venue contacts and were not stored. No phone number is published.

sources.title: Shifu Den events — Host at the Den
sources.reviewNote: “Host at the Den” opens the on-page Host an Event request form and says “Questions? Write to us at team@shifuventures.com”. No phone or WhatsApp number is published. The form was inspected, not submitted.
